items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: I vested a lot with Tony Perrani up there. He's still like a little chicken, you know. ... Tony was with the staff band at NBC one time. ... Tony Perrani don't have a copper center.

ctx.x: Up in New York, they do in Chicago, they have two.

Brooklyn's got a separate local, I know. Yeah. I have to have a book. I don't know what else to come up. I'll tell you the different locals, you know. I vested a lot with Tony Perrani up there. He's still like a little chicken, you know. What is he doing? Is he working with his staff? George, let me tell you. Let me tell you those jazz men around New York, including Miff Mole and people like that. Two nights a week. It was pitiful. Tony was with the staff band at NBC one time. Yeah. He was making $1,200 and…
Did he really write Tiger Rag and all those old tunes like Paranet Marmalade, these fellas? They're not one of you think?
